segments.sn35.180-182:1.1: 180-182. “Yaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ, tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.180-182:1.3: Rūpā, bhikkhave, dukkhā; tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.180-182:1.4: Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā dukkhā;
segments.sn35.180-182:1.8: tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn35.180-182:1.9: Yaṃ, bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ, tatra vo chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti.
